summary: Modern Greek uses είμαι broadly for identity, classification, property, state, and location, with existential/presentational meanings commonly using υπάρχει/υπάρχουν or other constructions.

semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: είμαι + state predicate; lexical verbs may encode particular states
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: είμαι + result-state adjective/participle where licensed; lexical result constructions also occur
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: είμαι + locative expression; βρίσκομαι is a lexical alternative
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: είμαι / γίνεται / λαμβάνει χώρα according to event construction
semantic_map.SEM.ORIGIN_AFFILIATION: είμαι από / nationality or affiliation predicate
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: not default; έχω is ordinary possession
